industries.description: The business unit provides specialty chemicals for a wide range of skin, hair, and body care products as well as household care products. We support industry development through collaboration and innovation.
Our business unit provides specialty chemicals for consumable goods. We prioritize sourcing top-quality ingredients and providing innovative solutions to meet our clients' changing needs.

The business unit provides specialty chemicals for Agriculture & Animal Care. Through innovative strategies and integrity-driven approaches, we build trust and foster long-term relationships with stakeholders.
The Industrial Solutions industry aims to lead in coating & construction solutions in Indonesia. We focus on continuous innovation, providing diverse paint raw materials to meet industry needs.

The Health & Hygiene industry provides vital raw materials and chemicals for products that promote cleanliness and well-being. With a focus on innovation, we enhance product efficacy and safety, contributing to better health and hygiene standards in communities.
With a focus on innovation and sustainability, the Paper, Packaging, and Export provide customized solutions to the needs of our clients across various industries.
